anomalies.observed: The isolated CAN transceivers U10 and U11 have both GND1 and GND2 pins tied to the same board GND net.
anomalies.expected: For the intended isolated CAN buses, GND1 and GND2 should be separate isolated reference grounds rather than shorted together on the common GND net.

evidence.quote: GND [High Power] : ... U10.4(GND1,power_in) U10.5(GND2,power_in) U11.4(GND1,power_in) U11.5(GND2,power_in) ...
two isolated CAN buses (CAN0, CAN1), each driven by its own MCP2515 SPI CAN controller (U8, U9) through an isolated CAN transceiver (U11/companion)

anomalies.impact: The galvanic isolation intended for the CAN interfaces is defeated, making the CAN buses susceptible to ground loops and common-mode noise and removing the isolation behavior described by the specification.

anomalies.observed: C13 is listed as 0.1mF 50V in a 0603 footprint, while its MPN and sibling decoupling capacitors indicate 0.1uF.
anomalies.expected: A 0603 decoupling capacitor on SERIAL_CAN_PWR_3.3V should be 0.1uF, consistent with C14 and the MPN CC0603KRX7R9BB104.

evidence.quote: C13 | 0.1mF 50V | Capacitor_SMD:C_0603_1608Metric | Device:C | Unpolarized capacitor | LCSC=C14663, MPN=CC0603KRX7R9BB104, Manufacturer= YAGEO

anomalies.impact: If the value field is used for sourcing or simulation, C13 represents an implausible 100uF 0603 capacitor instead of the intended 0.1uF decoupling capacitor, altering the modeled and potentially the physical power-rail behavior.

anomalies.observed: The WS2812 enable/power net /LED_3.3V_POWER_NONINV is only pulled down through R58 to GND and can be sunk by U34; it has no pull-up or push-pull source. This same net drives Q10 gate and U7 OE, both of which are active-high.
anomalies.expected: To enable the WS2812 LEDs, /LED_3.3V_POWER_NONINV should be able to go high (for example via a pull-up to +3V3 or a push-pull driver), turning on Q10 and enabling U7.

evidence.quote: /LED_3.3V_POWER_NONINV : D28.2(A,passive) D29.2(A,passive) D30.3(A1,input) D8.2(A,passive) Q10.1(G,input) R58.2(2,passive) U34.4(Y,output) U7.5(OE,input)
Addressable status LEDs (WS2812B, D5-D7, D18-D21) and an analog switch (ISL54222AIUZ, U5) for LED/signal routing.

anomalies.impact: The addressable LED power switch Q10 remains off and the level shifter U7 remains disabled, so the WS2812 status LEDs cannot operate as intended.

parsed.summary: The netlist shows a functional deviation from the intended isolated CAN architecture because both isolated transceiver grounds are tied to common GND. It also contains a clear passive-value inconsistency on C13 and an LED-enable net that is stuck low, preventing the WS2812 LEDs from being enabled.
